data.content_ref: inline:Replace the Boolean suspended label with a proof-object: a suspended node is accompanied by the finite set of defeating arguments that kept it OUT, and any reconsideration must be a polynomial proof-search over that certificate set rather than a relabeling or a fresh edge-construction pass. This strengthens the epistemic status of suspension without altering the fixed point's label set, but it imposes a proof-theoretic obligation that may not be decidable in polynomial time for arbitrary attacker sets, and it makes validity a property of certificates rather than of committed roots.
